what a failing M0 is doing: silently decoding or ignoring a token that is neither a macro nor even-length hex
silently decoding or ignoring an undefined name
accepting a macro body that is not a hex token
accepting a macro used before its definition
starting a comment at a # inside a token (4a#c is one unknown token)
resolving a reference to a label that is never defined (to 0, or to garbage) instead of stopping
